# Vendored browser libraries

Served locally so the page works without internet. Not Python dependencies.

| Library | Version | Licence | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| three.js | 0.187.0 | MIT (see `three/LICENSE`) | `three/three.module.js`, `three/three.core.js`, `three/addons/` (GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils, SkeletonUtils, meshopt decoder, CSS2DRenderer, OrbitControls) |
| GSAP | 3.15.1 | GSAP standard "no charge" licence (gsap.com/standard-license) | `gsap/index.js`, `gsap/gsap-core.js`, `gsap/CSSPlugin.js` |

Files are copied unmodified from the npm packages `three@0.187.0` and `gsap@3.15.1`.
